home.title: School Grading System
home.subtitle: One place for grades, reports, and progress. For students, teachers, and admins.
home.heroBullet1: View quarter, final, and competency grades in one dashboard
home.heroBullet2: Switch between academic years (Junior, Wheeler, Senior) with one click
home.heroBullet3: Secure login and role-based access for everyone
home.goal1: School Grading System is a central platform for managing and viewing student grades. It brings quarter grades, final exam results, and competency (Jadarat) assessments into one clear, easy-to-use place.
home.goal2: Students can see their performance by subject and by academic year. They can compare their results across years and track progress over time. Teachers and admins use the same system to enter and manage grades, so data stays consistent and up to date.
home.goal3: The goal is transparency: everyone sees the same numbers, reports are accurate, and the school has a single source of truth for academic performance.
home.audienceSubtitle: The platform serves students, teachers, and administrators with role-based access and tailored views.

audience.studentsDesc: Access your quarter grades, final grades, and competency results. Switch between academic years to view past and current performance.
audience.teachersDesc: Manage and submit grades for your classes. Enter quarter and final results, update competency assessments, and keep records consistent.
audience.adminsDesc: Oversee users, roles, and data to ensure accuracy and reliable academic reporting.

home.featuresSubtitle: Key features available on the platform.

features.quarterDetail: Track performance per subject during the quarter.
features.finalDetail: Semester final exam results in one table.
features.jadaratDetail: Specialization and competency assessments with attempt history.
features.yearsDetail: Switch between Junior, Wheeler, and Senior.
features.averagesDetail: Average grade and pass rates calculated for clarity and consistency.

home.achievementsSubtitle: Numbers that reflect our reach and impact.

achievements.studentsDetail: Active students viewing and tracking grades every term.
achievements.trackedDetail: All quarter, final, and competency grades visible in one system.
achievements.satisfactionDetail: Students and staff report high satisfaction with clarity and ease of use.
achievements.accuracyDetail: Single source of truth reduces errors and keeps reports reliable.

home.ctaSubtitle: Sign in to access your grades, switch academic years, and view all results.
